posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
If you are willing to wait till may, pledge to the Kickstarter for Shattered timelines, and take up one of the very nice people on the forums offer to pay for international shipping. Several members have offered - youll have to see if any still have the slots to do so - but you could pledge 30 to the kickstarter, and they will pledge an additional 40 as well. When the survey comes out you put each others names in with the explination, and theyll send you - for 30 dollars - Rook City and Unity and Ambuscade (20+5+5) - if youve got the spare cash you can add another 20 for Shattered Timelines too :p

 

(i think i have my moneys right)

 

Hope that helps

posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
HGM will charge you 20 singapore dollars (13 euro) for shipping on the promo decks, not sure what extra for Rook City. You may end up paying as much as with the eu shop. As others have mentioned the cost is in the same ballpark as backing the kickstarter, and you may have to wait until May to get Rook City on reprint anyway. At least with the ks you get three mini expansions included, more tokens, promo cards, and a bunch of other cool stuff - add Unity and Ambuscade and you are getting really good value compared to what all of this will cost you from more local retailers.

Bite the bullet my man, and join the funding!

My advice:

Pledge on Kickstarter

You can get Rook City, Shattered Timelines, and Unity/Ambuscade for $70 plus $40 shipping.  If you add another $40, you can get the just-announced Vengeance expansion (although if you don't want to wait you will have to pay an extra round of shipping)

 

If you look hard enough on the forums (you may not need to look too hard) you can find thread where people are offering to chip in to help lower the shipping cost.
